hoaxes.title: OpenAI's GPT-6.2 Sol will only answer questions between sunrise and sunset
hoaxes.truth: Made up. OpenAI is rolling GPT-6.2 Sol out to paid ChatGPT plans, with better instruction-following.

hoaxes.title: Blade Runner 2099 will ask Prime Video viewers to prove they are human before each episode
hoaxes.truth: Made up. All eight episodes of Blade Runner 2099 stream on Prime Video from November 25.

hoaxes.title: GTA VI's latest patch adds a mode where every driver in Vice City obeys the speed limit
hoaxes.truth: Made up. GTA VI update 1.002.002 is live on PS5 and Xbox, with seven official fixes reported.

hoaxes.title: Apple's iPhone 18e is said to come with a detachable camera that doubles as a webcam
hoaxes.truth: Made up. CAD images reported by 9to5Mac suggest an unusual new camera design for the iPhone 18e.
